description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 26.02.2024 to 03.03.2024
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and financial compliance, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (new regulations, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements). While it names P. B. S. C. Nonis as Director General of Customs, this is only to establish authority for the regulatory action and does not constitute a personnel appointment or describe portfolio responsibilities, so it does not qualify as a government personnel gazette.
